semantic_policy: minimal proposition_text plus evidence_refs; unchanged from frozen v3
source_basis: existing ordered LongMemEval RawSpan catalog only
primary_partition: greedily add complete turns in source order using exact rendered request budget tokens
oversized_single_turn: greedily partition the oversized turn into contiguous existing RawSpan groups; never split a RawSpan
overlap_policy: try preceding and following complete turns together; if both exceed the limit, prefer preceding; add following only if the preceding-priority combination still fits; if preceding alone does not fit, omit overlap

tokenizer_budget_view.budget_view: tokenize the exact rendered chat prompt followed by schema_prefix, canonical JSON of the exact dynamic JSON schema sent in response_format, and schema_suffix

rawspan_coverage: every existing source RawSpan belongs to exactly one primary chunk; oversized turns may have their RawSpans partitioned across consecutive primary chunks
cross_chunk_proposition_identity: SHA256 of canonical JSON containing stripped proposition_text and catalog-ordered canonical evidence_refs
cross_chunk_collapse: exact identity only; retain source chunk lineage; no paraphrase or semantic merging

duplicate_diagnostics.algorithm: SequenceMatcher ratio over casefolded proposition text
duplicate_diagnostics.purpose: diagnostic only; never merges propositions or changes writer policy
